prediction-test.title: IELTS Prediction Test
prediction-test.headline: Verify your realistic IELTS band score under full exam pressure before booking your official test date.
prediction-test.subheadline: Sitting the official IELTS costs real time and money. IELTS Prediction Test pairs full four-skill simulation conditions with calibrated scoring—and optional certified examiner review—so you walk into test day certain of your standing.
prediction-test.overviewTitle: Measure Real Test Readiness With Confidence
prediction-test.overviewBody: Taking short untimed quizzes often creates a false sense of security. An IELTS Prediction Test mirrors the full 2-hour-40-minute sequence across Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking—capturing fatigue management, timing discipline, and rubric alignment so you know whether you are truly ready for your goal band.

proofreading-translation.title: Proofreading & Translation
proofreading-translation.headline: Submission-ready academic proofreading and certified document translation for universities and scholarships.
proofreading-translation.subheadline: High IELTS bands unlock admissions requirements, while sharp Personal Statements, Scholarship Essays, CVs, and certified academic translations win selection committees.
proofreading-translation.overviewTitle: Clear Academic English Without Altering Your Authentic Voice
proofreading-translation.overviewBody: Generic automated paraphrasers strip personality out of scholarship narratives and occasionally introduce unnatural academic phrasing. Our experienced university writing editors refine grammar, narrative arc, paragraph flow, and register while preserving your exact achievements—alongside accurate certified academic translation.
